name: No Rush in Prospect 2027

venue.name: Oldham County Public Library - Goshen Branch
venue.details: Community Room - Enter Library and turn left - Conference room in the front.

information:
This event is not sponsored or endorsed by the Oldham County Public Library.

All minors must be accompanied by an adult. 

No Rush in Prospect 2027 is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/)
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBak44IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--5480638ed1b138c4bbe41a46a7e7dbb34d1406e2/MCA-Final-Logo%20(WCA%20website%20version).png)

No Rush in Prospect 2027 will be done in a stationary format, this format will be explained before the competition starts, and during the newcomer tutorial.
